chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to Jinn and Humans, highlighting the cognitive dissonance between recognizing divine favors and acknowledging their Source. The repetition underscores the concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' (Oneness of Action), urging believers to reflect on how they respond to Allah's continuous bestowals of grace in both the material and spiritual realms.
